name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-29 ガルドノヴァ[ブラウン]

description.ja: 30MMバイロン軍から待望の重量級量産機が登場！シリーズ初の量産機同士の合体機構を搭載！
description.en: The long-awaited heavyweight mass-produced machine from the 30MM Byron Army has arrived! Equipped with a combination mechanism between mass-produced machines for the first time in the series!

description.ja: • 胸部装甲と長い可動式アームが特徴的な機体。
description.en: • A unique aircraft with chest armor and long movable arms.

description.ja: • 腰部に可動式のフロントアーマーを採用。
description.en: • Adopts a movable front armor at the waist.

description.ja: • パーツの着脱でミドルアーム形態への組み替えが可能。
description.en: • Can be rearranged into middle arm form by attaching and detaching parts.

description.ja: • 脚部の可動域も広く様々なポージングが楽しめる。
description.en: • The legs have a wide range of motion, allowing you to enjoy various poses.

description.ja: • 武装はライフルが付属。
• シリーズ初の量産機同士の合体機構を搭載。別売りのレヴェルノヴァと合体すれば、重装甲機体を組み合わせて更に大型機体に！
description.en: • Equipped with a mechanism for combining mass-produced machines for the first time in the series. If you combine it with Revel Nova (sold separately), you can combine the heavily armored aircraft to create an even larger aircraft!

description.ja: • 既存機体やオプションパーツとのカスタマイズも可能。 無限のカスタマイズで自分だけの量産機を作り出せ！
description.en: • Can also be customized with existing aircraft and optional parts. Create your own mass-produced machine with unlimited customization!
